companies.name: ロッキード・マーチン
companies.sub: 防衛・航空機メーカー

relations.text: F-35戦闘機の機体メーカーで、プラット・アンド・ホイットニーのF135エンジンがその唯一の動力になる
relations.text_en: Lockheed Martin builds the F-35, which Pratt & Whitney's F135 engine exclusively powers

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Pratt & Whitney produces and sustains the F135 engine for the U.S. government’s F-35 Joint Program Office to exclusively power the single-engine F-35 Lightning II fifth generation aircraft (commonly known as the Joint Strike Fighter) produced by Lockheed Martin.

relations.text: コリンズ・エアロスペースの最大の民間向け顧客の一つで、ボーイングとエアバスの合計はコリンズ売上の2025年16%にあたる
relations.text_en: Boeing is one of Collins' largest commercial customers; with Airbus it was 16% of Collins segment sales in 2025

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Collins’ largest commercial customers are Boeing and Airbus with combined sales, prior to discounts and incentives, of 16%, 16%, and 19% of total Collins segment sales in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: コリンズの最大の民間向け顧客の一つで、ボーイングとの合計はコリンズ売上の2025年16%にあたる
relations.text_en: Airbus is one of Collins' largest commercial customers; with Boeing it was 16% of Collins segment sales in 2025

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Collins’ largest commercial customers are Boeing and Airbus with combined sales, prior to discounts and incentives, of 16%, 16%, and 19% of total Collins segment sales in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

companies.name: MTUエアロ・エンジンズ
companies.sub: 航空エンジン共同事業

relations.text: プラット・アンド・ホイットニーとIAEの共同事業を組み、61%のプログラム持分をP&Wが持つ
relations.text_en: MTU collaborates with Pratt & Whitney in IAE, where P&W holds a 61% program share interest

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Pratt & Whitney holds a 61 % program share interest in the International Aero Engines AG (IAE) collaboration with MTU Aero Engines AG (MTU) and Japanese Aero Engines Corporation (JAEC), and a 49.5 % ownership interest in IAE.

companies.name: GEエアロスペース
companies.sub: 航空エンジン合弁相手

relations.text: GE Aviationとの合弁エンジン・アライアンスが、エアバスA380のGP7000エンジンの補修部品とサービスを担う
relations.text_en: The Engine Alliance, a joint venture with GE Aviation, supports the GP7000 engine for the Airbus A380

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Pratt & Whitney is the principal participant in all existing collaborative arrangements, with the exception of the Engine Alliance (EA), a joint venture with GE Aviation, which provides aftermarket support, spare parts, and service for the GP7000 engine for the Airbus A380 aircraft.

relations.text_en: Raytheon Company has a joint venture with Thales, Thales-Raytheon Systems (TRS)

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: to resolve the previously disclosed criminal and civil government investigations into payments made by Raytheon Company and its joint venture, Thales-Raytheon Systems (TRS), since 2012 in connection with certain Middle East contracts.

companies.name: ロールス・ロイス
companies.sub: 航空エンジン事業の旧持分

relations.text: 2012年の契約でIAEの持分を取得した相手で、2027年6月まで飛行時間に応じた支払いが続く
relations.text_en: RTX acquired Rolls-Royce's IAE interests under a 2012 agreement and owes flight-hour payments through June 2027

source.label: RTX 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In addition, in connection with our 2012 agreement to acquire Rolls-Royce’s ownership and collaboration interests in International Aero Engines AG (IAE), additional payments are due to Rolls-Royce contingent upon each hour flown through June 2027 by the V2500-powered aircraft in service as of the acquisition date.
